items.title: Hinds plant manager earns President’s Lifesaving Award
items.summary: This article highlights the heroic actions of Joseph Wiggs, plant manager at Hinds Energy Facility in Jackson, Mississippi, who saved a life using the Heimlich maneuver at a local restaurant. Wiggs, trained in first aid and CPR through Entergy Mississippi, was honored with the President’s Lifesaving Award for his quick response and commitment to safety. The story emphasizes employee readiness, situational awareness, and the value of company-sponsored emergency medical training.
